# `org.rename`

Rename an organization

Session-only, organization owners. The old name keeps resolving until another organization takes it.

- Method and path: `POST /{org}/-/settings/rename`
- Scope: `repo:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie org rename`
- MCP: `org_rename`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `If-Match` | header | no | `string` |
| `name` | body | yes | `string` |
| `org` | path | yes | `string` |

`conflict`, `forbidden`, `not-found`, `precondition-required`, `stale`, `unauthorized`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
